about: Recorded results of 2026 award ceremonies, read from each organizer's own page (the owner's v6 package, 02-WORLD-AND-HISTORY.md E; November 13, 2026). The 83rd Golden Globe Awards and the 98th Academy Awards whole, every competitive category (from November 19, 2026; until then a small representative set): only what the cited page states is here, word for word, and a category a page doesn't state is absent, not guessed. Each observation is reportable from its publication date, never earlier. Names are kept as each source writes them.

editions: 33rd Hot Docs Canadian International Documentary Festival
coverage.notInSet: Every other 2026 ceremony and festival. The 74th San Sebastián festival from November 20, 2026: its official and honorary awards of September 26 (22); not its sections' selections, which its site builds with scripts, nor the industry, other and parallel awards. The 83rd Venice International Film Festival (2026) from November 20, 2026: the Competition from August 24, when NAZA completed it, the other sections from the September 2 opening, every official prize of September 12 and two lifetime Golden Lions; not the independent sections (Settimana della Critica, Giornate degli Autori) or the collateral awards. The 2026 Annecy International Animation Film Festival from November 20, 2026: its 14 sections (257 works, from the June 21 opening, as no dated announcement of the selection was found) and its 36 prizes, the special ones from June 26 and the official ones from the June 27 close (the France TV award for a short film isn't on its 2026 list). The 79th Festival de Cannes (2026) from November 20, 2026: every section of the Official Selection (76 features), the Short Film Competition and La Cinef, and its 21 prizes, each from the release that announced it; not the independent sections (Directors' Fortnight, Critics' Week, ACID) or the parallel juries' awards, which other bodies give. The 33rd Hot Docs festival from November 20, 2026: its 14 awards (the juried ones from May 1, the audience ones from May 4); not its program of 115 films, which the festival's site no longer lists. Series Mania 2026 from November 20, 2026: its five sections and opening and closing series (from the March 20 opening, as no dated announcement of the selection was found) and every prize of March 27, with the UGC spectators' label of April 4. The 76th Berlin International Film Festival from November 20, 2026: the films of Competition, Perspectives, Panorama, Forum, Forum Expanded, Generation, Berlinale Shorts and Berlinale Special (233), each section from the release that completed it, and the prizes of its official juries, its audience and its honorary awards (26); not the independent juries' prizes, nor the Retrospective, Berlinale Classics and Teddy 40 screenings of older films. The 48th Clermont-Ferrand International Short Film Festival from November 20, 2026: the 135 films of its international (60), national (51) and lab (24) competitions, shown from the January 30 opening as no announcement is dated, and its 29 prizes from the February 7 close. The 2026 Sundance Film Festival from November 20, 2026: every section's selection (97 features and episodic projects from December 10, 2025; 54 shorts from December 15) and every award of the January 30 ceremony and the short film awards of January 27 (the Park City Legacy screenings of earlier editions' films, and the mentorship and development grants, are not results). The 2026 Canadian Screen Awards whole from November 19, 2026, the winners of its four shows all shown from May 31, the date of the Academy's winners release. The 49th Japan Academy Film Prize from November 19, 2026: its 15 competitive categories (the newcomer and honorary awards have no Best), the Excellent Awards shown from the March 13 ceremony as their announcement states no date. The 2026 AACTA Awards from November 19, 2026: film, television, documentary and short film (48 categories), the nominees shown from February 4, 2026, the first ceremony, as their release gives no date. The 40th Goya Awards whole from November 19, 2026 (28 categories). The 51st César Awards whole from November 19, 2026 (24 categories; the honorary César has no field). The 41st Film Independent Spirit Awards whole from November 19, 2026 (20 categories). The 37th PGA Awards from November 19, 2026: the 10 categories decided on February 28 whole, and the children's and short-form winners of February 26 (not their nominees). The 78th Writers Guild Awards from November 19, 2026: the 15 categories the game holds and the WGA's page lays out alike (not the variety, quiz, daytime, news, radio or promotional ones). The 78th DGA Awards from November 19, 2026: every category's nominees but Commercials, and every winner but Comedy Series, which the DGA's release doesn't state as a winner. The 32nd Actor Awards are recorded whole from November 19, 2026 (15 categories). The 2026 Emmys are recorded whole from November 19, 2026: all 120 categories' winners, and the nominees of the 117 whose page lists a field (three list only their winners: two juried awards and an area award). The 83rd Golden Globe Awards (from goldenglobes.com/nominations/2026) and the 98th Academy Awards are recorded whole from November 19, 2026; until then five Golden Globes were, and the night's article, which names The Pitt and The Studio as series winners without saying which won which, left both out (the nominations page says: The Pitt, Drama; The Studio, Musical or Comedy).
